about: USD per million tokens, keyed by the exact model setting. Used only to turn measured tokens into a cost per question; edit freely. A model missing here reports tokens but no cost. Anthropic's cache WRITES (1.25x input) are not modelled, so Claude costs are slightly understated on a cold cache.
